purpose: Separate aggregate-only diagnostic of why 8,830/9,603 WebFetch records in PRIVATE293 failed the frozen physical-call identity admission rule. This study must not recalculate overlap, relax PRIVATE293, or convert excluded records into evidence.

selection.rank: ascending sha256('seenrelay-private293-phase-a-v1\0' + UTF8(path)); ties by raw UTF-8 path

geometry_checks.note: PRIVATE293 removed zero physical duplicates, so all-three-present equals its unique physical WebFetch count.

decision_rules.sessionId_only_gap: If at least 95% of missing records have assistant uuid and tool_use id present but sessionId absent, a separate preregistered source-native session-identity diagnostic may be commissioned. No overlap rerun is authorized.
decision_rules.assistant_uuid_only_gap: If at least 95% of missing records have sessionId and tool_use id present but assistant uuid absent, retain the source as physically underidentified unless a separately preregistered source-native event identity can be proven. No overlap rerun is authorized.
decision_rules.tool_use_id_only_gap: If at least 95% of missing records have sessionId and assistant uuid present but tool_use id absent, retain the source as physically underidentified unless a separately preregistered source-native tool identity can be proven. No overlap rerun is authorized.
decision_rules.mixed_gap: Otherwise classify the missing-identity population as mixed and do not attempt to rescue PRIVATE293 from this diagnostic.
